page_title: LIL 1-0 ANG | Lille v Angers 02/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Lille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Hamza Igamane (Lille) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save. The linesman makes the right call and Lille will have a corner.
90+2' Himad Abdelli (Angers) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Jerome Brisard shows the yellow card to Calvin Verdonk (Lille) for a heavy challenge.
88' Lille fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) is coming onto the pitch as Felix Correia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
83' Here's the change. Haris Belkebla leaves the pitch and Lanroy Machine (Angers) comes on as a substitute.
83' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Louis Mouton and he is replaced by Marius Courcoul (Angers).
82' Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
82' Thomas Meunier (Lille) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
78' Substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson walks off the pitch and Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
78' Bruno Genesio decides to make a substitution. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo will be replaced by Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
76' The free kick is taken by Himad Abdelli (Angers), but ball is cleared.
74' Lille fail to score from a corner as Herve Koffi (Angers) leaps to collect the ball.
72' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Sidiki Cherif is replaced by Prosper Peter (Angers).
71' The substitution is prepared. Hamza Igamane (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Olivier Giroud.

68' Olivier Giroud (Lille) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Herve Koffi, who pulls off a comfortable save!
67' A huge rebound finds Felix Correia (Lille) unmarked on the edge of the box. He lines up a shot but slips just before he hits it and sends the ball miles wide of the left post.
67' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' The ball rebounds to Benjamin Andre (Lille) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
66' Lille force their opponents to concede a corner.
61' Here is a change. Amine Sbai is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Harouna Djibirin (Angers).
61' Substitution. Lilian Raolisoa is replaced by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
58' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
54' Olivier Giroud (Lille) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar.
53' Angers work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
53' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
53' Amine Sbai (Angers) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

52' Louis Mouton (Angers) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Angers will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' Felix Correia (Lille) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post.
51' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) picks up a long through ball, but Herve Koffi deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
50' A cross, provided by Calvin Verdonk (Lille), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger.
48' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Jerome Brisard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Felix Correia (Lille). Ayyoub Bouaddi plays a fantastic through ball and finds Felix Correia (Lille), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
39' Carlens Arcus (Angers) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
38' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Louis Mouton (Angers).
38' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is able to continue to play.
36' Benjamin Andre (Lille) picks up an injury.
32' Flag goes up against Sidiki Cherif (Angers) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
30' Benjamin Andre (Lille) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
28' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
28' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
26' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is adjudged offside.
26' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) got to the ball inside the six-yard box all of a sudden and slammed it towards the goal, but unfortunately hits one of his teammates instead of scoring.
25' What a big chance! Felix Correia (Lille) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
24' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
21' Jordan Lefort (Angers) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Berke Ozer.
20' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' Jordan Lefort (Angers) strikes the ball on goal from the resulting free kick, but his effort goes wide.
17' Amine Sbai (Angers) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
12' Himad Abdelli (Angers) touches the ball with his hand.
11' Benjamin Andre (Lille) watches the corner all the way, but places his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
11' The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
11' A pass into the penalty area from Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is intercepted by the defence.
7' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' Herve Koffi displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
4' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
